name: parallelogram-dashboard
description: A BEM-style CSS dashboard library inspired by shadcn/ui

scripts.build: sass scss/main.scss dist/parallelogram-dashboard.css && cp dist/parallelogram-dashboard.css demo/css/parallelogram-dashboard.css && npm run vendor && npm run llms
scripts.vendor: rm -rf demo/vendor && mkdir -p demo/vendor && rsync -a --exclude dev --exclude types --exclude '*.map' node_modules/@parallelogram-js/core/dist/ demo/vendor/parallelogram-js/
